answer: Bonded identity stops Sybils by pricing each persona. To join the market an agent posts a refundable bond and a verifiable history of completed work; cheating forfeits the bond and burns the reputation it took months to build. A lotus does not bloom overnight, and neither does trust: new accounts start with narrow limits that widen only through honest trades. A falcon-fast attacker could spawn a hundred shells, but funding every bond and nursing each quill-signed record to credibility costs more than any single scam can return.
